name.en: Glink Clinic Ho Chi Minh City (Phòng khám Glink Tp.HCM 1)

address.en: 224/38 Lý Thường Kiệt, Phường 14, Quận 10, Ho Chi Minh City

services.note: Branch page lists rapid HIV and STI testing, PrEP, PEP, HIV treatment (ART), transgender health and mental health (by appointment). Glink says PEP should start no more than 72 hours after exposure. The transgender health service lists hormone-use counselling and monitoring; it doesn't say whether hormones are prescribed. A 2018 case study says services are paid, with discounts or free screening for clients who can't pay, and that Glink was Vietnam's first private clinic licensed for HIV treatment (2017). Hours and prices aren't published: call first.

name.en: Phòng khám Đa khoa Galant (Galant General Clinic) – District 5

address.en: 104 Trần Bình Trọng, Phường 1, Quận 5, Ho Chi Minh City

providers.hours: Daily 08:00–20:00 (per Hello Bacsi and Medpro; Docosan lists 09:00–17:00).

services.note: Directories list HIV testing (HIV Ag/Ab combo about 169,000 VND; basic STI panel about 399,000 VND per Medpro), STI testing and treatment, PrEP and PEP counselling and prescribing, and HIV treatment. In 2019 SGGP reported Galant was the first private clinic licensed to give HIV medicines (ARVs) under Vietnamese health insurance. A 2017 Nhân Dân report gave the address as 119 Trần Bình Trọng and said the clinic has a counselling room for transgender people. Galant also lists branches in Bình Thạnh (Yên Đỗ street) and Tân Bình. The clinic has no official website we could find; call or visit to confirm.

address.en: 6 Nguyễn Lương Bằng, Tân Mỹ Ward, Ho Chi Minh City

services.note: FV says its mental health specialists assess, diagnose and treat ADHD, using stimulant and non-stimulant medicines; three psychiatrists list ADHD and the psychiatry team says it sees children, adolescents and adults (the ADHD page itself doesn't give an age range, so ask when booking). Endocrinology unit manages diabetes, prediabetes and metabolic disorders, plus children's growth and puberty disorders; a dedicated diabetes centre is listed as work in progress (2026). International private hospital; DFAT lists Chinese, French, Japanese, Khmer, Korean and Russian, and FV's psychiatrists list English. Fee-paying.
